source_coordinate_roles.x: retinal eccentricity from foveal center, mm
source_coordinate_roles.not: visual angle; ganglion-cell soma coordinates; RF/visual-field position
source_coordinate_roles.surface: The paper reconstructs three retinal pieces on a retinal sphere. Do not silently interpret these as a new planar projection or convert to visual angle without a separate verified mapping.
source_coordinate_roles.directions: Anatomical retinal nasal, temporal, superior, inferior; source maps put nasal left, temporal right, superior up. Do not confuse with opposite visual-field directions.
source_coordinate_roles.foveal_center: In Methods p169, located at point of highest apparent cone density.

Packer1989_nemestrina_photoreceptor.uncertainty: Conservative ±4px on both native image axes; ±6px for rod points below1mm where shapes overlap. Propagated worst-case coordinate/density errors are per row. These are readout uncertainty bounds, not 95% confidence intervals and not inter-animal variability. Residual glyph-center ambiguity is covered approximately, not statistically validated.

biological_limits.sample_size: Three cone retinas; two rod retinas. Table1 provides individual peaks/totals but graph curves average across retinas.
biological_limits.counting_repeatability: Methods p168: repeated measurement range below3%; local adjacent cone-field range below10%; rod adjacent-field range about5% out to70 degrees, up to20% beyond. These are context, not per-point error bars.
biological_limits.shrinkage: Methods pp169–171: approximately5% areal /2.2% linear shrinkage; authors did not correct it. We did not silently apply a correction.
biological_limits.central_rods: Results p173 reports occasional rod as close as20um eccentricity and generally only one or two per counting window out to100um; Discussion p181 says scattered rods within about20um. This is an observation scale, not proof every individual has a hard20um circular rod-free boundary. Our Fig9 picks begin near0.4mm; do not label extrapolated0–0.4mm as measured curve.
biological_limits.central_cones: Selected Fig6 points begin around0.05mm; source Table1 mean peak210,000/mm2 can be used as an independent scalar observation at the foveal center, not a direction-specific raw sample.
biological_limits.lm_ratio: L:M=1:1, if retained, is a simulator assumption and is not measured by this paper. Packer identifies all cones, not L vs M vs S.
not_done: Original count coordinates/table (not publicly provided here)

scalar_constraints.notes: Usually1–2 rods per counting window out to this eccentricity; not an areal density observation.

Packer1989_rod_digitized_temporal.uncertainty: Conservative ±4px on both native image axes; ±6px for rod points below1mm where shapes overlap. Propagated worst-case coordinate/density errors are per row. These are readout uncertainty bounds, not 95% confidence intervals and not inter-animal variability. biological_limits.sample_size: Three cone retinas; two rod retinas. Table1 provides individual peaks/totals but graph curves average across retinas.
biological_limits.counting_repeatability: Methods p168: repeated measurement range below3%; local adjacent cone-field range below10%; rod adjacent-field range about5% out to70 degrees, up to20% beyond. These are context, not per-point error bars.
biological_limits.shrinkage: Methods pp169–171: approximately5% areal /2.2% linear shrinkage; authors did not correct it. We did not silently apply a correction.
biological_limits.central_rods: Results p173 reports occasional rod as close as20um eccentricity and generally only one or two per counting window out to100um; Discussion p181 says scattered rods within about20um. This is an observation scale, not proof every individual has a hard20um circular rod-free boundary. Our Fig9 picks begin near0.4mm; do not label extrapolated0–0.4mm as measured curve.
biological_limits.central_cones: Selected Fig6 points begin around0.05mm; source Table1 mean peak210,000/mm2 can be used as an independent scalar observation at the foveal center, not a direction-specific raw sample.
biological_limits.lm_ratio: L:M=1:1, if retained, is a simulator assumption and is not measured by this paper. Packer identifies all cones, not L vs M vs S.
